title: Stabilize toolchain: migrate to CUDA 12.2 + Triton 2.x + CUTLASS 3.x with kernel compatibility shims
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: Our pinned GPU toolchain (CUDA 11.x + Triton 1.x + CUTLASS 2.x) is blocking new kernel optimizations, recent hardware (H100 A100 variants) fixes, and packaging updates. Multiple internal teams hit symbol/ABI mismatches when trying to compile newer kernels, and CI images diverge from production nodes.

Goal: Perform a controlled migration to CUDA 12.2, Triton 2.x and CUTLASS 3.x while preserving runtime compatibility for existing models. Deliver a compatibility shim layer, CI matrix updates, and a staged rollout that keeps observable thresholds (p50/p99 latency and throughput) within acceptable regression budgets.

Scope:
- Upgrade base Docker images to nvidia/cuda:12.2-runtime-ubuntu22.04 and rebuild GPU worker images.
- Move Triton submodule to 2.1.x (or latest 2.x stable) and adapt kernel registration macros used by our custom fused operators.
- Integrate CUTLASS 3.x API changes (epilogue and store policies) and add wrapper adapters for legacy calls still used in a few kernels.
- Add an ABI/symbol compatibility shim (shared object with weak symbol wrappers) to allow mixed-version builds during transition.
- Expand CI matrix: run canary builds on CUDA11 and CUDA12 nodes, add perf gating to nightly and PR pipelines.
- Add compile time flags and NVCC gencode adjustments to support sm_80, sm_86, sm_89 targets used in prod.

Acceptance criteria:
- All existing unit/integration tests pass on CUDA12 image in CI.
- No more than 5% increase in median token latency and 7% in p99 across representative workloads (chat-gen small, chat-gen long, embedding throughput).
- Canary cluster serving production traffic with new runtime for at least 48 hours with automated rollback triggered on SLO breaches.
- Documentation updated for build/dev workflow and dev laptops (README + internal confluence).

Non-goals: Full removal of CUDA11 support during this ticket (we keep fallback images), rewriting major kernels for CUTLASS 3 idioms (follow-up tickets will optimize).
acceptance_criteria: CI - CUDA12 image: all tests green
Performance regression: median latency <= +5% and p99 <= +7% on benchmark set
Canary run: 48h with no SLO breaches
Developer docs and build matrix updated
rollback_plan: If canary p99 breaches or error rate > 0.5% sustained for 15m, trigger automatic rollback: 1) scale new runtime pods to 0 in canary, 2) redeploy previous runtime container tag, 3) postmortem and revert PRs if root cause in code. For CI breakage, pin pipeline to CUDA11 images and open hotfix branch. Documented rollback runbook in Confluence.
ci_changes: Add CUDA12.2 runner label and dedicate 4 machines for PR canaries
Matrix jobs to run both CUDA11 and CUDA12 for critical builds
Add perf-gate job that runs the benchmark harness and fails PRs with >5% median regression
Nightly deployment job to canary cluster with health checks
benchmarks_summary: Initial baseline (CUDA11): chat-gen-small median=12.4ms, p99=48ms. Target on CUDA12: median <=13.1ms (<= +5%), p99 <=51.4ms (<= +7%). Embedding throughput baseline 800 req/s, aim to be within 95% of baseline or better. Detailed benchmark results will be attached to PRs.
risk_mitigation: Compatibility shim to allow mixed-version artifacts during rollout
Keep CUDA11 container tags in registry for quick rollback
Performance budget and automated gating to prevent silent regressions
Coordinate with infra to stagger node image upgrades by region
